subtitle: A decision log your AI can search when you ask why.
about: A note for decisions, the options considered, the reasons and when to revisit them, plus open questions. Tell your AI what you chose to log a decision, or ask why you made an earlier one.

ask.prompt: Set up the decision log template in my Pinto Notes.

slides.label: Log a decision
slides.you: On Tuesday we picked Stripe over Paddle. Paddle's fees were higher and it can't do usage billing, which the AI plan needs.
slides.ai: Logged it as Stripe for payments, 17 November.
slides.alt: The Stripe decision in the log

slides.label: Later, ask why
slides.ai: Your log says two reasons: Paddle cost more, and it can't do the usage billing the AI plan needs.
slides.alt: The Stripe entry the answer quotes

slides.label: Use it yourself
slides.alt: Decision log as it starts, ready to fill in
